description: Send a startup or SaaS product to the NutsGrowth review queue, the way the form at /submit does. A person reads every suggestion and writes the listing by hand, so it takes days. If the website is already listed, the answer gives its page and how to claim it; if it is already in the queue, when it arrived. Fill in what you know from the product's own site; leave out what you do not. Ask the person before sending.

audience.description: Who it is for: up to 8 short labels, each at most 40 characters.

country.description: Where the company is based: an ISO code such as "DE", or the name.

email.description: The person's email, only if they gave it to you for this. NutsGrowth's promise about it, as /submit makes it: "We email you once, when it is listed — with a link to claim it if it is yours — and only otherwise to ask a follow-up question. Seen only by whoever reviews the queue, never published, and in no export. Leave it blank and the submission is still read."

open_source.description: True if it is open source.

overview.description: What it does, in a paragraph or two (at most 3000 characters).

price.description: What it costs, as pricing_url shows it, which is then required. A person checks it against that page before the listing shows any price. Leave it out if the page gives no US dollar price.

amount.description: The cheapest paid plan, in US dollars as the page states it. Never converted.

on_request.description: No public price: the vendor quotes.

pricing_url.description: The page where its prices are published, as a full https:// address.

replaces.description: Products it is a practical substitute for.

self_hostable.description: True if it can be run on your own servers.

tagline.description: One line on what it does.

tags.description: Up to 8 tag slugs from list_filters. One not in use is kept as a suggestion for the person reviewing it, not applied, and the answer names it.

url.description: Its website, as a full https:// address.

value_prop.description: Why somebody switches to it (at most 400 characters).

name: submit_tool
title: Suggest a product for the directory
